program.listTaken.message: {list} already has a referral program. Each list has one.

program.listUnknown: That list doesn't exist. Pick another list.
program.listFixed: The list can't change once the program has been on.
program.checksFail: Fix the failing checks to turn the program on.
program.alreadyOn: The referral program is already on.
program.alreadyOff: The referral program is already off.
program.deleteOn: Turn the program off before deleting it.
program.senderUnknown: That sender doesn't exist. Pick another one.
program.replyTo: Write the reply-to address as name@domain.
program.stale: Someone saved these settings since you opened them. Reload to see their changes, then save yours.
program.headlineName: Keep {first_name} in the headline: it becomes the referrer's name, or “A reader”.
program.shareLink: Keep {link} in the share message: it becomes the reader's own link.
program.periods: Pick at least one period for the leaderboard.
program.shareButtons: Show at least one way to share.

milestone.countTaken.message: There's already a milestone at {count, plural, one {# referral} other {# referrals}}. Pick another number.

milestone.fileOrURL: Upload a file, or give the address readers download it from.
milestone.fileUnknown: That file isn't one of this program's files any more. Upload it again.
milestone.url: Give a download address that starts with https://.

milestone.webhookURL.note: detail: why the endpoint can't be used

milestone.webhookHTTPS: Give an endpoint that starts with https://.
milestone.couponNeedsStripe: Connect Stripe in Earn › Settings › Payments first.
milestone.couponNeedsEarnAlone: Coupon rewards need earn:edit, which nobody in this workspace holds.
milestone.offer: Pick an offer of the kind “Referral reward”.
milestone.imageUnknown: That image isn't in the library any more. Pick it again.
milestone.programOnLast: The program needs at least one milestone while it's on. Add another one first, or turn the program off.
milestone.emailStale: This email was saved somewhere else since you opened it. Reload to see that version.
milestone.noEmail: This milestone has no email. Turn the email on first.
file.tooLarge: Files can be up to 100 MB.
file.type: Upload a PDF, a ZIP file or an image (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP).
codes.none: The upload has no codes. Put one code on each line.
codes.tooMany: Upload up to 100,000 codes at a time.
codes.long: Codes can be up to 200 characters.
codes.notCodes: This milestone's reward isn't a code from a list.
reward.notManual: Only manual rewards are marked fulfilled.
reward.notFulfill: This reward isn't waiting to be fulfilled.
reward.cantResend: This reward hasn't gone out yet, so there's nothing to resend.
reward.noClaim: This reward has no claim link.
review.none: Pick the held referrals to decide on.
review.notHeld: Some of these referrals aren't held for review any more. Reload the queue.
review.oneReferrer: Decide on one referrer's referrals at a time.
review.undoLate: Undo is no longer possible: the decision was made more than 10 seconds ago or a reward has gone out.

notify.heldTitle.message: {count, plural, one {# referral held} other {# referrals held}} for review
notify.heldTitle.note: count: referrals waiting in the review queue

notify.heldBody.message: {names}. Held referrals don't count until someone decides.
notify.heldBody.note: names: referrers with their held counts, “Alex Moreau (6), Mateo Silva (3)”

notify.codesLowTitle.message: {reward}: {left, plural, one {# code left} other {# codes left}}
notify.codesLowTitle.note: reward: the reward's name; left: codes not used yet

notify.codesLowBody: Upload more codes before they run out. New rewards wait until codes are added.

notify.codesOutBody.message: {waiting, plural, one {# reward is waiting} other {# rewards are waiting}}. They go out as soon as you add codes.

notify.webhookBody.message: {url} answered {status} to the last {calls, plural, one {call} other {# calls}}. Rewards wait and are retried for 6 hours.
notify.webhookBody.note: url: the endpoint; status: its last answer; calls: failed calls in a row
